item.text: I’ll process the VTI field with TTK’s persistence simplification and render the requested sublevel-set persistence diagram (orders 0 and 2), saving the result in the workspace.

item.command: /bin/bash -lc "ls -lh QMCPACK.vti && head -n 12 QMCPACK.vti && find / -type f \\( -name pvpython -o -name paraview -o -name ttkPersistenceDiagramCmd \\) 2>/dev/null | head -30 && find / -type f -name python3 2>/dev/null | head -20"

/bin/bash -lc "ls -lh QMCPACK.vti && head -n 12 QMCPACK.vti && find / -type f \\( -name pvpython -o -name paraview -o -name ttkPersistenceDiagramCmd \\) 2>/dev/null | head -30 && find / -type f -name python3 2>/dev/null | head -20"

/bin/bash -lc 'PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH pvpython - <<'"'PY'
from paraview.simple import *
for n in ['TTKPersistenceDiagram','TTKTopologicalSimplification','TTKPersistenceDiagramClustering','TTKPersistenceCurve']:
 try:
  x=globals()[n]()
  print(n, x)
  print(x.ListProperties())
  Delete(x)
 except Exception as e: print(n, type(e).__name__, e)
PY
PATH=/opt/conda/bin:"'$PATH ttkPersistenceDiagramCmd --help | head -100'

/bin/bash -lc 'PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH pvpython - <<'"'PY'
from paraview.simple import *
for n in ['TTKPersistenceDiagram','TTKTopologicalSimplification','TTKPersistenceDiagramClustering','TTKPersistenceCurve']:
 try:
  x=globals()[n]()
  print(n, x)
  print(x.ListProperties())
  Delete(x)
 except Exception as e: print(n, type(e).__name__, e)
PY
PATH=/opt/conda/bin:"'$PATH ttkPersistenceDiagramCmd --help | head -100'

/bin/bash -lc "find /opt/conda -iname '*topological*simplification*' -o -iname '*persistence*diagram*.xml' | head -40
PATH=/opt/conda/bin:"'$PATH pvpython - <<'"'PY'
from paraview.simple import *
r=XMLImageDataReader(FileName=['/workspace/QMCPACK.vti'])
r.PointArrayStatus=['Scalars_']
pd=TTKPersistenceDiagram(Input=r)
pd.ScalarField=['POINTS','Scalars_']
UpdatePipeline(proxy=pd)
print('outputs',pd.GetDataInformation().GetNumberOfPoints(),pd.GetDataInformation().GetNumberOfCells())
for i in range(pd.GetDataInformation().GetNumberOfDataSets()): print(i)
pd.GetDataInformation().GetPointDataInformation().GetArrayInformation(0)
print('arrays', [(pd.GetDataInformation().GetPointDataInformation().GetArrayInformation(i).GetName()) for i in range(pd.GetDataInformation().GetPointDataInformation().GetNumberOfArrays())])
print('cell',[(pd.GetDataInformation().GetCellDataInformation().GetArrayInformation(i).GetName()) for i in range(pd.GetDataInformation().GetCellDataInformation().GetNumberOfArrays())])
SaveData('/workspace/raw_pd.vtp',proxy=pd)
PY"

/bin/bash -lc "find /opt/conda -iname '*topological*simplification*' -o -iname '*persistence*diagram*.xml' | head -40
PATH=/opt/conda/bin:"'$PATH pvpython - <<'"'PY'

print('outputs',pd.GetDataInformation().GetNumberOfPoints(),pd.GetDataInformation().GetNumberOfCells())
for i in range(pd.GetDataInformation().GetNumberOfDataSets()): print(i)
pd.GetDataInformation().GetPointDataInformation().GetArrayInformation(0)
print('arrays', [(pd.GetDataInformation().GetPointDataInformation().GetArrayInformation(i).GetName()) for i in range(pd.GetDataInformation().GetPointDataInformation().GetNumberOfArrays())])
print('cell',[(pd.GetDataInformation().GetCellDataInformation().GetArrayInformation(i).GetName()) for i in range(pd.GetDataInformation().GetCellDataInformation().GetNumberOfArrays())])
SaveData('/workspace/raw_pd.vtp',proxy=pd)
PY"
